summary: First testing pass on Vitality Health app. Backend (Node/Express behind FastAPI shim on port 8090) and frontend (React+Vite mobile shell) both healthy after the port-8010 collision / Vite ESM / ts-node-dev fixes. 14/14 backend regression tests pass. Frontend: all 7 screens render with real seeded data, bottom nav + FAB + AddActionModal + navigation all wire up correctly, paywall modal opens on locked podcast tracks, Activity Insight opens as modal without navigation loop, weight update persists to Dashboard, reminders/leaderboard render.

minor.issue: Enum validation for invalid mealType returns 500 (Mongoose ValidationError bubbled up) instead of 400. Non-blocking because frontend only sends valid enum values ('BREAKFAST'|'LUNCH'|'DINNER'|'SNACK'), but the controller should catch ValidationError and return 400.

issues: React Router v6 future flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) logged repeatedly to console - cosmetic only

action_items: (Optional) Wrap Mongoose validation errors in nutrition/activity controllers to return 400 instead of 500 for enum/type violations.
(Optional) Opt into React Router v7 future flags to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend controllers rely on generic try/catch that lets Mongoose ValidationError produce 500; consider mapping to 400.
NutritionLog.mealType enum is uppercase-only; make sure any future clients don't send lowercase.
ToastProvider timer (2.2s) is short - could be missed by slow users; consider 3-4s.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seed data (Grace, 7-day activity, today's nutrition breakfast/lunch, 5 podcasts, 5 leaderboard, 3 reminders). Tests wrote a TEST_ prefixed nutrition log and updated Grace's weight to 58.5kg / added 2x 250ml water drinks - all persisted successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://health-hub-802.preview.emergentagent.com (note: /app/frontend/.env also has an unused VITE_BACKEND_URL pointing to eff468f8-... which is stale but harmless since app uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). All routes are /api/v1/*. Backend enums: mealType must be UPPERCASE ('BREAKFAST'|'LUNCH'|'DINNER'|'SNACK'). Weight update payload key is 'weightKg' (not 'weight'). Bug-fix from previous iteration (port 8010 collision + Vite ESM + ts-node-dev orphans) is confirmed resolved: /api/v1/health returns 200, no 404s, no orphaned-process issues after supervisor restart.
rca_of_the_issue: Prior bug (Express on port 8010 colliding with an unrelated platform system process, plus Vite/PostCSS ESM crash, plus ts-node-dev orphans) was fixed before this test run by (1) moving Node/Express to port 8090 via NODE_SERVER_PORT in backend/.env, (2) removing 'type':'module' from /app/frontend/package.json, (3) switching Express dev script from ts-node-dev to ts-node, and (4) adding fuser -k cleanup in the FastAPI proxy shim. Regression verified: 14/14 backend endpoints return expected 2xx status, no port conflicts, supervisor shows both frontend and backend RUNNING.
